_meta.purpose: The flock's pending/done log — MCS-11. A reminder and its record are ONE object: an item is created 'pending' with a due date, and when the work is done the SAME item becomes the record of what happened (status 'done', done_date, result). No separate to-do list and history that drift apart.
_meta.owned_by: operator/agent — items are added as work is planned and closed as it is done. Consumed read-only by scripts/pending_done.py, which also SUGGESTS new pending items from the current triage but never auto-writes them.
_meta.lifecycle: pending -> done (with done_date + result) | cancelled (with reason). done/cancelled items are kept, never deleted — the log is the record.

schema.action: what to do (free text, e.g. 'check FEC', 'deworm', 'CDT booster')
schema.target: sheep id, a cohort name, or 'flock'
schema.created: ISO date the item was raised
schema.due: ISO date it is due (or null)
